header: This is the introduction to the search bar at the top of the user guide (text in src/lib/help/searchBarIntro.ts): what the bar is, how to start, what it covers, what it cannot do yet.

symbols.name: BarPicture
doc: I draw the bar in small: the two rows of buttons under the box, from the same lists the bar reads, so the picture cannot differ from the bar. Nothing here is pressable.

symbols.name: SearchBarIntro
symbols.sig: export function SearchBarIntro({ onOpenUtility, onOpenEds }: { onOpenUtility?: () => void; onOpenEds?: () => void } = {})
doc: `onOpenUtility` and `onOpenEds` take the reader to the Utility Services and Deep search (EDS) tabs; when they are given, the pointers under More tools are buttons.
